name: verbatim-compaction
description: Rule-based verbatim compaction for Claude Code sessions: stale tool output is deleted, nothing is summarised, nothing leaves the machine.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages never touched. The first message is always kept.

resultBudgetChars.title: Verbatim tool output budget
resultBudgetChars.description: Characters of tool output kept verbatim, newest first; older output is cut to head and tail.

keepUnderChars.title: Always keep results under
keepUnderChars.description: Results at or below this size are never cut, because cutting them saves nothing.

headChars.title: Head kept when cutting
headChars.description: Characters kept from the start of a cut tool result.

tailChars.title: Tail kept when cutting
tailChars.description: Characters kept from the end of a cut tool result (where errors usually are).

dropSupersededCalls.title: Remove superseded read calls
dropSupersededCalls.description: Remove a read whose file was read or written again later, instead of keeping an empty record of it. Calls that changed something are never removed.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction
minReductionRatio.description: Below this share of characters removed, Claude Code's built-in summary is used instead.

compactAtPercent.title: Auto-compact at context percent
compactAtPercent.description: Ask for compaction once the context is this full. 0 leaves the timing to Claude Code.
